name: Potassium electrolytes
summary: Blood pressure support; muscle function; safety screen: kidney disease; ACE inhibitors/ARBs; potassium-sparing diuretics.
description: Potassium electrolytes support physiologic electrical gradients and can contribute to blood pressure regulation and muscle function in deficiency states.
safetyNotes: Potassium supplementation can be dangerous with kidney disease or potassium-retaining medications.
contraindications: chronic kidney disease or reduced glomerular filtration rate due to impaired renal potassium excretion
ACE inhibitor or ARB or potassium-sparing diuretic medication due to a well-documented additive hyperkalemia risk
baseline serum potassium above the normal range
Addison's disease or other hypoaldosteronism conditions due to impaired aldosterone-mediated potassium excretion
concurrent NSAID use due to reduced renal potassium clearance
evidence_grade_explanation: The recorded grade (strong evidence) and evidence tier (preliminary evidence) conflict, so the weaker signal is published pending review.
evidence_rationale: No study design has been recorded for this profile yet.
